tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Paper is the default (site, documents, ads); Vault is for the trading app at night, video and social where the paper would glare. Every other colour is defined against it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, certificates, sheets lying on the ground: the Offer card, the Certificate, modals. Separated from `paper` by a `rule` hairline, never by a shadow.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: inputs, the address well, table header rows, code.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card borders, 1px. Decorative only: it is 1.7:1 on `paper`, so a border that carries meaning (a focused field, a selected row) uses `rule-strong`.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: control outlines, table dividers that separate meaning, the focus ring's inner line. 3.3:1 on `paper`, 3.4:1 on Vault `paper`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunk` (11:1 or better in both themes). Also the single-ink logo on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, timestamps, helper lines, the tagline. 5.6:1 on `paper`, 6.2:1 on `paper-raised` (Paper); 7.7:1 and 6.4:1 in Vault. Never for figures a person acts on.

tokens.name: intaglio
tokens.usage: The brand green, named for the engraved ink on securities. Primary buttons, the dome mark on paper, selected states, links. As text on `paper`: 7.8:1 (Paper), 4.9:1 (Vault). Put `on-intaglio` on it.

tokens.name: intaglio-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of `intaglio` fills; the darker half of the two-tone mark.

tokens.name: on-intaglio
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `intaglio` fill. 7.8:1 (Paper), 5.0:1 (Vault).

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Gold leaf: the dome's highlight, the premium figure's underline, the OPEN stamp, selected tabs' underline. A fill or a line, never small text on `paper` in the Paper theme (2.6:1): use `gilt-ink` for text there.

tokens.name: gilt-ink
tokens.usage: Gold as text: premium amounts, the OPEN stamp's word, yields. 5.3:1 on `paper` (Paper), 9.6:1 (Vault).

tokens.name: on-gilt
tokens.usage: Text on a `gilt` fill. 5.6:1 (Paper), 8.6:1 (Vault).

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The coin. Bitcoin amounts' disc, the BTC glyph, deposit confirmations. A fill or glyph colour; for copper text use `copper-ink`.

tokens.name: copper-ink
tokens.usage: Bitcoin amounts and addresses as text. 6.0:1 (Paper), 7.8:1 (Vault).

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Refusals and errors: the REFUSED stamp, a failed settlement, a destructive button, an invalid field. As text: 8.0:1 (Paper), 5.2:1 (Vault). It is the only red in the system.

tokens.name: on-oxblood
tokens.usage: Text on an `oxblood` fill. 8.2:1 (Paper), 6.0:1 (Vault).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: a 2px solid outline, offset 2px, on every control. Green in Paper (7.8:1 on `paper`), gilt in Vault (8.3:1 on `paper`); never a glow.

styles.name: display-1
styles.sample: Earn on Bitcoin you still hold.
styles.usage: Hero lines on the site, title cards in video, the first slide. One per surface.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Section openers, ad headlines, slide titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and panel titles in the app; the certificate's heading.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Astrid keeps her 2 BTC and the $6,000.
styles.usage: Standfirsts and pull quotes. Italic Fraunces is the brand's one flourish; use it for the human sentence, never for data.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings inside the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If Bitcoin ends above the strike, your coins are sold at the strike and you keep the premium.
styles.usage: Default body copy, form labels, descriptions.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Helper text, table cells, captions under figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and column headers, uppercase. Set `text-transform: uppercase` in CSS.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: The word inside a Stamp, uppercase. Every status carries its word; colour alone never carries state.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one number a screen is about: the premium, the position size, the countdown.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Every amount, price, strike, date and block height in running UI. Tabular by default.

styles.name: figure-small
styles.usage: Addresses, transaction hashes, timestamps, block numbers. Truncate hashes in the middle with an ellipsis: `bc1q…5mdq`.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Certificates and cards use the larger steps generously; the trading table uses the small ones. Nothing sits on a half step.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between a stamp's border and its text, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; row gaps in dense tables.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical), gaps between fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button padding (horizontal); the default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a page; the certificate's inner margin.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections; the hero's bottom inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop; slide margins.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between hero and content on the site; poster margins.

radius.note: Square by default, like a certificate. Only the coin is round.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Cards, certificates, tables, inputs, stamps. The default: paper has corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips, so they read as pressed into the paper rather than cut from it.

tokens.name: radius-coin
tokens.usage: Discs only: the coin, the dome's disc, avatar circles, the countdown ring.

shadow.note: Paper lies flat. Depth comes from `rule` borders and `paper-sunk` wells, not shadows. The one shadow lifts a modal or a certificate in a photograph.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Modals, the certificate when it is the hero of a page, a dragged row. Nowhere else.

stroke.note: Engraving lives in line weight. These are the only stroke widths.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules, card borders, guilloche lines at print size.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: The dome mark's line at 24–64px, focus rings, the countdown ring.

tokens.name: stroke-plate
tokens.usage: The dome mark above 64px; the stamp's border; the certificate's outer border.
